student_learning_goal: I can determine whether addition and subtraction expressions are equivalent.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can determine whether addition and subtraction expressions are equivalent.
header.character_watermark: Eddy in the top-right corner. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Test 8 pairs of add/sub expressions. Decide EQUIVALENT or NOT.
parts.visual_layout: Top of page. Eight pair rows.

image_placeholders.description: Eight pair rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 4in. Each row: pair + EQUIVALENT/NOT bubbles. Pre-filled: '50+25 vs 100-25', '60+40 vs 80+20', '75-25 vs 25+25', '100+50 vs 200-50', '40+30 vs 80-10', '90-30 vs 30+30', '500-100 vs 200+200', '250+50 vs 350-50'. Header 'Equivalent?'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P1_PAIRS: keywords (equivalent) name the bubbles.

parts.student_instructions: For each given expression, write a different expression that's equivalent.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of page. Four partner-finding rows.

image_placeholders.description: Four rows in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2.5in. Pre-filled given expressions: 50+50, 100-25, 200+50, 175+25. Each row: 'Equivalent: ___'. Header 'Find a Partner:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P2_PARTNER: keywords (partner) name what the slots ask for.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each must equal the given expression.

parts.student_instructions: Write 3 of your own equivalent pairs using both + and -.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of page. Three blank slots.

image_placeholders.description: Three numbered pair slots in B&W line-art, ~7in x 2in. 'Pair ___: ___ = ___'. Header 'My Pairs:'.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS02_P3_OWN: keywords (my, pairs) name the slots.

parts.answer_key: Open. Each pair must be equivalent.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, write a pair where both sides have 3 terms.
teacher_notes: Lesson 2 worksheet. Watch for surface-similarity trap.
